Discuss a wedding brief

A little more
before we say cheers.

Can we organise everything from the USA?

We can discuss your bar in English by WhatsApp or email and coordinate the details remotely with you and your planner. Share your destination and date so we can check the practical arrangements.

Do you cover Madeira as well as mainland Portugal?

Yes — we welcome enquiries for both mainland Portugal and Madeira. Availability, travel, transport and venue requirements are assessed for each event and confirmed in your proposal.

What is included, and how much does it cost?

Each quote is tailored to the date, location, guest count, service hours and drinks you choose. Staffing, drinks, bar equipment, glassware, setup, travel and any personalisation are itemised or clarified in your proposal. There are no assumed package inclusions.

Can you offer alcohol-free drinks?

Yes. We can plan alcohol-free cocktails alongside your cocktail menu. Tell us about guest preferences and any dietary requirements when we prepare the proposal.

Our venue is not confirmed yet. Can we still get in touch?

Absolutely. An approximate date, area and guest count are enough to start a conversation. We confirm logistics and the final scope once the venue details are available.
